orb.$description: The orb: the light you drag when exploring glass in Storybook. A small glass marble that glows in its theme's color. The glow is wide on purpose: it's the light itself. Full pages never show one; their light stays at light-from-right and light-top.

size.$description: The marble, in three sizes on the 8px grid: 16, 32 and 48. Medium is the usual one.

small.$description: The height of body text, so it sits beside words. Try it out windows use it.

medium.$description: The usual orb: glass stories and the Glass playground.

target.$description: The button around the marble: the touch target, never under 44px.

glow.$description: The light from a glowing orb (look glow). Clear orbs have none.

falloff.$description: The step the light fades in, as a share of the ball's size: very bright within one step, then thinner and thinner.

reach.$description: How many steps the light reaches before it's gone: far enough to cover the whole section with no visible edge.

highlight.$description: The crescent where light catches the top of the glass.

pool.$description: Light pooling at the bottom, after passing through the glass.

rim-thick.$description: The rim along the bottom, where the glass is thickest.

rim-thin.$description: The rim at the top, where the glass is thinnest.
